module.purpose: Validates queued workflow-email payloads and either sends custom email content or builds booking event context for workflow reminder delivery.
module.summary: This task module supports two workflow-email execution paths. It validates either a complete custom email payload or a lazy payload referencing a booking and workflow reminder. Lazy payloads are resolved through booking repositories, transformed into calendar event data, enriched with video-call metadata, and processed by the email workflow service. Eager payloads are delivered concurrently to every recipient through the custom workflow email service.
module.businessContext: Supports automated booking workflow notifications, including reminders and custom emails. Failures can prevent customers, hosts, or attendees from receiving important scheduling and meeting information.
classes: ZSendWorkflowEmailsSchemaEager (~L12-28): Validates complete custom workflow email payloads and optional attachments.
ZSendWorkflowEmailsSchemaLazy (~L30-33): Validates identifiers for deferred booking workflow email generation.
ZSendWorkflowEmailsSchema (~L35-38): Accepts either eager email content or lazy workflow identifiers.
functions: sendWorkflowEmails (~L40-88): Validates queued payloads and dispatches custom or booking-based workflow emails.
systemCapabilities: Send custom emails to multiple recipients

io: Reads booking data through BookingRepository using prisma.
Reads workflow reminder and booking seat data through repository-backed EmailWorkflowService.
network: Sends custom workflow emails through sendCustomWorkflowEmail.

detail.signature: export async function sendWorkflowEmails(payload: string): Promise<void>
preconditions: payload must be a JSON string that conforms to ZSendWorkflowEmailsSchema
postconditions: All intended emails are sent (either via EmailWorkflowService.handleSendEmailWorkflowTask or sendCustomWorkflowEmail) and the function resolves without returning a value
edgeCases: If mailData contains both bookingUid and workflowReminderId, a single workflow email is sent after validating booking and calendar event existence.
If booking is not found, the function throws an Error with message "Booking not found".
If calendar event cannot be built, the function throws an Error with message "Calendar event could not be built".
If mailData lacks bookingUid/workflowReminderId, emails are sent in parallel to each address in mailData.to via sendCustomWorkflowEmail.
detail.summary: Parses a workflow email payload and dispatches either a single workflow email via the EmailWorkflowService or multiple custom workflow emails, ensuring required booking and calendar data exist before sending.
